node.statement: Assume inductively a_{2^k}>=r_+. Node 1.3 gives a_{2^{k+1}}>=a_{2^k}/2>=r_+/2>1/8>r_-; applying the dichotomy from node 1.2 at level 2^{k+1} forces a_{2^{k+1}}>=r_+. Thus all dyadic levels have this bound. For arbitrary n choose 2^k>=n; node 1.3 gives a_n>=a_{2^k}>=r_+>=1-C_diag e. Unfolding a_n proves the root contract for every Z.
